# polaris_policies (Data Source)

Lists the policies defined in a namespace of a Polaris catalog. Use `polaris_policy` for the details of one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "polaris_policies" "compaction" {
  catalog     = "lakehouse"
  namespace   = ["governance"]
  policy_type = "system.data-compaction"
}

output "compaction_policies" {
  value = data.polaris_policies.compaction.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) The name of the catalog.
- `namespace` (List of String) Namespace the policies are defined in, as an ordered list of levels.

### Optional

- `policy_type` (String) Only list policies of this type, e.g. `system.data-compaction`.

### Read-Only

- `names` (List of String) Names of the policies, in the order returned by Polaris.
